👤 About Me - A Closer Look

A glimpse into how I think, learn, and explore.

I am currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) at REVA University, Bengaluru.

I believe growth comes from staying curious, embracing change, and being willing to explore beyond what I already know. In a field that continues to evolve, I see learning as an ongoing journey — one that involves discovering new technologies, keeping up with emerging developments, and expanding the way I think.

For me, learning becomes more meaningful when it moves beyond theory and takes shape in practice. I aim to apply the concepts and technologies I explore through real-world projects, turning new knowledge into practical experience and ideas into working solutions.

As I continue my journey, my goal is to remain adaptable, keep exploring new possibilities, and build with purpose — growing not only in what I know, but also in how I apply it.
